name: FlashArray - QoS cap (day 2)
description: An operator asks for an IOPS cap on a volume. The request is logged, a human approves it, the cap is applied through the FlashArray collection with the eda/qos_cap tag the performance rulebook lifts again once latency is normal, and the outcome is logged with the AAP job link. A rejection is logged too and changes nothing.

scope.title: If the volume is in a volume group with its own QoS
scope.description: The array refuses a volume limit inside a rate-limited volume group: notify records the refusal and changes nothing, vgroup caps the whole group instead (lifted the same way), volume tries the volume cap anyway and records the array's refusal

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume name, with its pod (pod::volume) or volume group (vgroup/volume) prefix when it has one

iops_limit.title: IOPS limit
iops_limit.description: The cap to apply, in IOPS, as purefa_volume takes it: a whole number from 100 up to but excluding 100000000, the value the array stores as no limit

extra_vars.subject: Cap ${trigger.volume} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.iops_limit} IOPS: awaiting approval
extra_vars.detail: Requested through the orchestrator. Approve or reject within 24 hours.

parameters.prompt: Cap volume ${trigger.volume} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.iops_limit} IOPS. The previous limit is kept in an eda/qos_prev_iops tag on the volume; the performance rulebook lifts the cap once the volume's latency has been normal for its configured number of polls, and a lift can also be launched from FlashArray - QoS cap with mode lift.

extra_vars.reason: requested through the orchestrator (FlashArray - QoS cap (day 2))

extra_vars.subject: QoS cap for ${trigger.volume} on ${trigger.array}: ${qos_cap.artifacts.cap_target} at ${qos_cap.artifacts.applied_iops} IOPS
extra_vars.detail: Cap target: ${qos_cap.artifacts.cap_target} (volume group: ${qos_cap.artifacts.volume_group}; refused: ${qos_cap.artifacts.refused}). Previous IOPS limit: ${qos_cap.artifacts.previous_iops} (changed: ${qos_cap.artifacts.changed}). The volume or its group carries the eda/qos_cap tag until the cap is lifted. AAP job: ${qos_cap.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: QoS cap of ${trigger.volume} on ${trigger.array} at ${trigger.iops_limit} IOPS rejected or expired; nothing changed
extra_vars.detail: The approval was rejected or timed out after 24 hours. Raise a new request if the cap is still wanted.
